events.label: Sun hidden by Earth during the 14 March 2025 total lunar eclipse

events.quote: View of Earth blocking the light of the sun, creating a bright ring of light in the lunar sky.

missions.name: IM-1 Odysseus (Intuitive Machines), near Malapert A
